 Recusal
 In the exercise of my official duties as Minister of Veterans Affairs and Associate Minister of National Defence, I recused myself on February 20, 2023 from participating in any discussion or decision regarding a senate nomination in order to avoid any appearance of preferential treatment or any opportunity to further the private interest of Jane MacAdam, my relative by marriage.
 Administrative Monetary Penalty
 Violation of subsection 25(5) of the Conflict of Interest Act:
Failure to make a public declaration of gifts within 30 days after accepting the gift or other advantage.
